invalidReason.invalidType: Not a valid combination (single, pair, triple, straight, pair run, bomb, or joker bomb)
invalidReason.wrongType: Match the table's combination type — you can't play a different type
invalidReason.wrongCount: Play the same number of cards as the table
invalidReason.tooWeak: You need a higher rank than the table
invalidReason.needBomb: Only a bomb or joker bomb can beat the table's bomb
invalidReason.unbeatable: The table's joker bomb cannot be beaten

tutorial.tableCards: Cards on the table. Play the same combination type and count with a higher rank — suits never matter.
tutorial.playerHand: Your hand. Click cards to select them.
tutorial.playPass: Play selected cards or pass your turn (you cannot pass on a lead).

hint.canPlay: You have a combination that beats the table
hint.shouldPass: Nothing beats the table — consider passing
hint.playLow: You lead — shed your weaker cards first

announce.yourTurnLead: It's your turn. You're leading, so you can't pass.
